links.outcome: GPT-4 identification completeness and misidentification of cerebral hemorrhage types on CT
links.effect: Overall identification completeness 72.6% (SD 18.6%); chronic subdural completeness only 37.3%; misidentification 26.2% to 54.0% across hemorrhage types.
links.quote: The overall identification completeness percentage for the 6 types of cerebral hemorrhages was 72.6% (SD 18.6%).

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating the standalone diagnostic accuracy and completeness of GPT-4 on CT images of cerebral hemorrhages, with expert radiologist rating of outputs, but without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
